# ConfigParams

One configuration XML tree. The instances are `VescIf.mcConfig()`, `VescIf.appConfig()`, `VescIf.infoConfig()`, `VescIf.fwConfig()` and `VescIf.customConfig(index)`. Parameters are addressed by XML name, e.g. `mMcConf.getParamDouble("si_motor_poles")`; `getParamQString()` returns the same value as text for display.

Signatures use C++ types. In QML: `QString` is a JS string, `QVector<T>` and `QStringList` are JS arrays, `QVariantMap` is a plain JS object, `QVariantList` an array, `QByteArray` an `ArrayBuffer` (read with a `DataView`), and `QVariant` anything.

Generated from vesc_tool `a34c1727` (working tree dirty).
